lead: Bhagwant Mann has built a public profile as an Indian politician, born on 17 October 1972 in Satoj.

The sections that follow break down Bhagwant Mann's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Bhagwant Mann — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Bhagwant Mann was born on 17 October 1972 in Satoj, and holds Indian nationality.

sections.heading: Bhagwant Mann — Career and Professional Work
paras: Bhagwant Mann works primarily as a politician, actor and screenwriter.

He has held the following offices: Member of the 16th Lok Sabha (2014–2019), Member of the 17th Lok Sabha (2019–2022), Chief Minister of Punjab (2022–present) and Member of the 16th Punjab Legislative Assembly (2022–present). He is affiliated with Aam Aadmi Party.
